page.overview:
Who is Stennis?

Stennis was the son of King Demavend III and thus the rightful heir to the Aedirnian throne. While he was the lawful heir to the king, he ran into trouble getting crowned.

Stennis grew up at the Aedirnian court. During his upbringing, he sought recognition from his father and future subjects, but received none. This led him to resent and look down upon the peasantry in particular, being a firm believer in the divine right of his royal lineage to rule.

During the second war for Upper Aedirn, Stennis set out in the hope of preventing Henselt from crossing the Pontar while his father would defend the capital. Stennis arrived too late to prevent Henselt's crossing and chose to await him at Vergen. He then fought in the ensuing battle. When Sabrina Glevissig summoned Melgar's Fire and brought devastation to both armies, he gathered what few survivors he could and retreated deep into the country before travelling back to Vengerberg. He arrived in time to witness the news of the carnage reaching the capital.

During the last months of his father's reign, a peasant revolt defeated and scattered the royal forces at the river Dyfne, after which King Demavend III was assassinated. Stennis stood to inherit a realm in chaos, yet at this critical moment he lacked the support of Aedirn's great houses to be crowned. At this time, Henselt once again sought to conquer Upper Aedirn. In this, Stennis saw a chance to gain the support he needed to be crowned king. He set off for Vergen with the nobles who did support him, as well as Vengerberg's Hierarch Olcan Grandemot, where the leader of the peasant revolt, Saskia, had gathered her forces to repel the Kaedweni invasion. Stennis sought to gain glory and support by aiding in the defeat of the Kaedweni king and his forces, portraying himself as the realm's saviour. He disliked Saskia the Dragonslayer due to the peasantry being enamoured with her. While he did not do it himself, he allowed Olcan to prepare to poison Saskia. He attended negotiations with Henselt alongside Saskia in a bid to avert open war.
